text.title: Internal Link Audit Decision Tree
text.summary: Routing tree mapping observable crawl and link-graph signals (site size, crawl reconciliation, link position split, cluster reciprocity) to a rule from 01-core-rules.xml. Every leaf references a rule id.

decision-tree.root-question: Does the site have at least 30 published indexable content pages and at least one declared topic cluster (pillar plus 5 or more cluster pages)?

conclusion.verdict: too small for a graph audit; fix links by hand while publishing and return when the site passes 30 pages

branch.question: Is there a full rendered crawl from within the audit period whose indexable page count reconciles with the XML sitemap and CMS count within 5 percent, or with every gap explained?

conclusion.verdict: rerun or rescope the crawl and reconcile counts before any orphan, hub or cluster analysis

branch.question: Are incoming links split by position so that contextual (main content) counts are available separately from navigation, footer, sidebar and breadcrumb links?

conclusion.verdict: export link position from the crawler and recompute every per-page count on the contextual column

branch.question: Has the pillar-to-cluster and cluster-to-pillar link matrix been built for every declared cluster?

conclusion.verdict: build the matrix per cluster; every missing edge becomes a rewire item
graph is trustworthy; produce orphan decisions, anchor distribution, hygiene findings, fully specified rewire plan and the Search Console baseline

text.example: site_qualifies=true -> crawl_reconciled=true -> position_split=true -> cluster_matrix_built=true -> conclusion ref=run-the-checklist
